high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) at the National Library of Medicine (NLM), NIH.gov. The URL displayed at the top indicates the source of the content. The text on the page discusses the self-reference effect (SRE), a psychological phenomenon where individuals prioritize the perception and processing of self-related stimuli over stimuli unrelated to the self.
